Subject: Sandbox vs Dedicated: trial scope & success criteria (post-call)

Hi Jordan / Elena — thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap & proposed plan from Redwood to help decide hosting for the POC/trial.

Call takeaways:
- Goal: Validate generation latency at 2k prompt tokens, assess cost/throughput, and verify security posture for PHI workflows.
- Key success criteria:
  - Latency: p95 ≤ 350ms for 1k seq, ≤ 700ms for 2k seq on dedicated pool
  - Token cost: < $0.0015 per token (target, measured across 24-hour steady-state batch)
  - Functional: pass 95% of evaluation prompt set (shared)
  - Security: prove network egress controls + audit logs for last 30 days
- Recommended first step: 2-week hosted sandbox (fastest to start) with synthetic data and a small subset of real prompts; follow with VPC or Dedicated trial if security gating requires.
- Timeline: Hosted sandbox start by Nov 16, measurement window Nov 17–30, decision call Dec 1.

Action owners / asks:
- Acme: confirm whether you can use synthetic data for the initial sandbox (Jordan). Provide list of blocked IPs if you need VPC now.
- Redwood: provide trial plan & firewall requirements (Ben) — attached trial plan v1.
- Tech sync: schedule a 30–45m runbook call w/ Marissa + Karthik this week.

Attachments:
- [Attachment: redwood_trial_plan_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

Short next steps:
1) Jordan confirm synthetic-data OK by EOD Mon (Nov 9)
2) Redwood to send firewall/IP list and kickoff calendar invite (Ben)

Thanks — Ben

Thanks Ben — quick replies inline.

- Synthetic data: OK for initial perf run, but we need to validate on a 1000-record de‑identified sample before any production-like test.
- Data residency: we prefer US-only; if hosted sandbox routes through EU, that's a blocker.
- VPC: we'd prefer VPC or Private for PHI. However, we can start with hosted sandbox if it's guaranteed not to persist data beyond the trial and logs can be restricted.
- Network: I'll loop in infra team if you send the ingress/egress IP ranges.

Can you also confirm whether dedicated trial requires a minimum commit? Not urgent but good to know.

Jordan

Jordan — copying the snippet of your note:

> Data residency: we prefer US-only; if hosted sandbox routes through EU, that's a blocker.

Short answers and technical notes:
- Hosted sandbox: we can guarantee US region only for the sandbox (us-west2). We will not persist customer prompts beyond 72 hours in the sandbox unless you opt in.
- Logs/audit: we can scope audit log retention to 30 days for the trial; access controls via RBAC.
- VPC option: requires a short network exchange — see attached network diagram and firewall template. For a 1-week VPC setup, we'll need your infra to open the inbound firewall ranges listed and accept our signed certs.
- Dedicated: min commit for dedicated capacity is typically a 3-month reserved window for capacity reasons; we can discuss a short-term dedicated pilot but it will have different pricing.

Technical metrics to capture during the sandbox:
- p50/p95 latency by seq len
- tokens/sec throughput with batch size configs
- KV cache hit rate
- error rate by API route

I'll prepare a one-pager mapping metrics to dashboard tiles and share by Monday.
